On 2026-09-01, CHG-35 (Complete and harden the existing Lead Lab password-recovery flow) was implemented on branch `feature/forgot-password`. The local automated flow now covers uniform known and unknown email responses, active administrator and participant accounts, pending and revoked accounts, branded notification content, 60-minute expiry, single-use tokens, throttling, password confirmation, database-session invalidation, remembered-login rotation, and non-sensitive audit logging. The full PHP suite passed 126 tests with 968 assertions, and PHPStan, Pint, TypeScript, ESLint, Prettier, the Vite production build, and `git diff --check` passed. Docker and Mailpit were unavailable during verification; live SMTP inbox, browser, staging, production-mail, monitoring, participant-data, and operational ownership evidence remain open.
